channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye says opposes military operation against Iran
item.description: Türkiye has reiterated its opposition to a military operation on Iran following escalation between Washington and Tehran while urging the latter to engage in diplomacy to resolve its regional problems, as well as its authentic internal matters.

item.title: Istanbul enforces ‘zero tolerance’ food safety policy
item.description: The Istanbul Governor’s Office has issued a comprehensive directive emphasizing a policy of “zero tolerance in food safety,” instructing all district municipalities and relevant public institutions across the city to tighten controls and enforcement.

item.title: Gambling addiction cases surge 155-fold in six years, data shows
item.description: Gambling addiction in Türkiye has escalated at an alarming pace, with the number of people seeking professional help increasing 155-fold in just six years, turning the issue into a rapidly deepening social crisis.

item.title: Sakarya Gas Field output to double in 2026: Energy minister
item.description: Production at the Black Sea’s Sakarya Gas Field will double in 2026, marking a pivotal year for the country’s energy transformation, Energy and Natural Resources Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said.

item.title: Türkiye, Romania to boost migration cooperation
item.description: Interior Minister Ali Yerlikaya said Türkiye and Romania agreed to take concrete steps to strengthen cooperation on combating terrorism, organized crime and irregular migration, following talks in Bucharest.

item.title: Vice president, ministers hold talks with US envoy
item.description: Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz and Defense Minister Yaşar Güler met with Tom Barrack, U.S. ambassador to Türkiye and special envoy for Syria, in separate meetings to discuss defense ties, trade and the security landscape in neighboring Syria and Iran.

item.title: SDF blocks civilian evacuation from eastern Aleppo
item.description: The YPG-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on Jan. 16 continued attempts to block the safe evacuation of civilians from the Deir Hafer area, which the Syrian army has designated a military zone, sources and media have reported.

item.title: US says Iran halts executions as Gulf allies pull Trump back from strike
item.description: The United States on Thursday said Iran halted 800 executions of protesters under pressure from President Donald Trump, after Gulf allies appeared to pull him back from military action over Tehran's deadly crackdown on demonstrations.

item.title: Turkish, Baltic top diplomats meet in summit to discuss Europe’s security
item.description: Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan met his counterparts from the Baltic countries in Lithuania on Jan. 16 to discuss security implications of the ongoing Russian occupation of Ukraine and securing Baltic airspace under NATO missions.

item.title: Gaza ceasefire plan faces great uncertainty
item.description: The White House has announced it is moving into the second phase of President Donald Trump’s Gaza ceasefire plan, aimed at rebuilding Gaza and reshaping the broader Middle East, though details remain scarce.
